column3: NKJV has “your women,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the women.”
NKJV has “the commandments of the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “a command of the Lord.”
NKJV has “let him be ignorant,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “he is not recognized.”
